_comment: The assembler's -G is a separate knob from the compiler's: cc1 -G8 decides
which objects are eligible for the small-data area, but the assembler's -G
decides whether a reference is emitted as offset($gp) or as a %hi/%lo pair.
The original build did not use one setting throughout -- functions that
address through $gp need as_G 8, while functions that use %hi/%lo for a
symbol of the same size need as_G 0. Recover per file with tools/flagsweep.py.
